pinterest.title: What to Test First in Canva AI 2.0

snippet.title: Friday watchlist: the AI tools worth testing are the ones that fit a workflow
snippet.description: Choose one tool this week that fits into a real workflow, not a demo. Test Canva for creation, Google’s ad panel for review, or Claude Reflect for self-audit, and keep the scope small enough that you can tell whether it actually saved time.Read the full Clearforge breakdown through the link in our bio. Prefer to listen? Search ‘Clearforge AI Briefing’ on your podcast provider.
